title: Design System: Viện Phương Nam - Phân tích định lượng với R

display.purpose: The single H1; italic phrase in cobalt.

title.purpose: Table row heads, ruled-list titles, names.

label.purpose: Uppercase terms and table column heads.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; depth is tonal and linear. Only inset tab indicators and a 1px invalid ring exist.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All transitions and the figure plot-in.

motion.name: figure-plot-in
motion.value: points 0.5s (11ms stagger), fit line 1.1s at 0.55s, band 0.7s at 0.95s, annotations 0.6s at 1.5s
motion.purpose: The one authored motion moment; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on paper and plate fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--cobalt, #0a3d91); color: #fff; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 1rem/1.2 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-deep, #072c6b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a3d91; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #0d1b2a; border-radius: 2px; color: #0d1b2a; background: transparent; font: 600 1rem/1.2 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0d1b2a; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a3d91; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 600 0.9375rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #0d1b2a; } .ds-req { color: #c4231a; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 50px; margin-top: 7px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #7f93b0; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #0d1b2a; font: 400 1rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #0d1b2a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a3d91; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #0a3d91; }

components.name: Figure Plate
components.description: Cobalt field holding a figure and its numbered caption.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; padding: 28px; background: #0a3d91; color: #fff; } .ds-plate figcaption { margin-top: 14px; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #cfe0ff; } .ds-plate figcaption strong { color: #fff; }

components.name: Ruled Abstract List
components.description: Definition list with a heavy top rule and hairline rows; the deadline value is red.
components.css: .ds-abstract { margin: 0; border-top: 2px solid #0d1b2a; } .ds-abstract div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd4e1; } .ds-abstract dt { padding-top: 4px; font: 700 0.8125rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #566780; } .ds-abstract dd { margin: 0; font: 400 1.0625rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #0d1b2a; } .ds-abstract .is-deadline dd { color: #c4231a; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Figure Tab
components.description: Tab on a 2px ink rule; active is cobalt with a 5px inset underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); border-bottom: 2px solid #0d1b2a; } .ds-tab { padding: 16px 20px 18px 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: 600 1.125rem/1.3 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #3a4a5f; box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 transparent; transition: box-shadow 0.25s, color 0.2s; } .ds-tab strong { color: #566780; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #0d1b2a; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: #0a3d91; box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 #0a3d91; } .ds-tab.is-active strong { color: #0a3d91; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a3d91; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a journal manuscript. Each section is a Figure or a Table the learner will learn to make. Structure comes from rules (heavy 2px ink rule above, 1px hairline between rows), not from boxes. Voice is the figure caption: plain, numbered, exact.

Density is editorial and calm. White paper carries text; a pale plate tint (#f3f6fb) alternates with it for section fields; one cobalt field carries evidence plates and the closing section. Red appears only for the registration deadline and required-field marks.
keyCharacteristics: Booktabs rules: 2px ink top rule, 1px hairline row dividers, 2px ink bottom rule on tables and lists.
Serif for claims and numbers, sans for reading and controls.
One cobalt field per view at most: the plate, the registration aside, the close.
Figures are generated, labelled as simulated, and annotated with leader lines.
No gradients as decoration, no glass, no particle or canvas atmosphere, no fake product mockups.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is a field, not a trim. It fills a plate or a section; it is not used as a border colour on neutral cards or as a decorative gradient.

rules.name: The Red Is An Instruction Rule
rules.body: Signal red means deadline or required. A decorative or brand use of red is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Field Rule
rules.body: Section fields use the plate tint (#f3f6fb) instead of pure white. Known and accepted deviation from a pure-white paper; keep it as the only alternate ground.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Dates, prices, phone numbers and step counts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Figures and tables carry a numbered caption (Hình n, Bảng n) in bold lead plus plain sentence.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Group with a ruled list or table, not a bordered, shadowed container.

dos: Do write every date, fee, discount condition, contact, payment datum and faculty fact from the official notice (assets\THÔNG BÁO_v.2_CHUỖI KHÓA NCKH (01.2027).docx, the newest); the H1 follows its title "Phân tích định lượng với R – Từ cơ bản đến chuyên sâu".
Do label every generated figure as simulated illustration.
Do use rules and numbered captions to structure content.
Do keep course codes as internal form values, never public copy; do not duplicate the notice's QR asset.
Do keep red for the deadline and required marks, and cobalt as a field.
donts: Don't present simulated data as research results, or the form as having submitted anything.
Don't add navy particle heroes, glass chrome, gradient text or fills, or an AI-chat/workbench mockup.
Don't wrap content in bordered, shadowed cards when a rule or table will do.
Don't set body text below 17px or rendered chart text below 11px.
Don't introduce an invented notice number or unreconciled figures.
